summary: TeeBox iteration 3 backend + frontend verification. Backend: 8/8 pytest passed in /app/backend/tests/test_iter3.py (course catalog seeded with 30 famous courses including Augusta, Bandon Dunes, St Andrews; /api/discover/courses merges master + rounds with correct shape and played-first sort; /api/courses/{name} returns avg_rating null when no reviews and rounded to 2 dp when present; POST /api/courses/reviews rounds 3.6 → 3.5 and accepts 4.25 as-is; rating <1 or >5 rejected 422; author.handicap included in review list; OSM bad-bbox → 400; OSM missing auth → 401; live OSM call skipped — Overpass returned 502 which is the expected fallback per spec). Frontend (Expo web preview, iPhone-390 viewport): logged in as reese@teebox.demo; Discover → Courses shows played courses first (Bandon Dunes 1 play · Avg 88, etc.) then master catalog alphabetically; famous courses (Augusta National, Bandon Dunes, St Andrews, Pebble Beach, TPC Sawgrass) present; each row shows 'city, region' below the name (Augusta, GA / Bandon, OR / St Andrews, Fife). Tapped Augusta National → /course/Augusta%20National%20Golf%20Club; hero shows name + 'Augusta, GA, USA' pill + white 'Open in Maps' pill. Intercepted window.open — course-open-maps opens 'https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=Augusta%20National%20Golf%20Club%20Augusta%20GA'. StarPicker tap at 40% width set the numeric pill to '2.00 / 5.00'; tap at 85% set it to '4.25 / 5.00'. Filled course-review-input and tapped course-review-submit — review persisted with rating 4.25, hero pill updated to '★ 4.25 · 1 reviews' (course-avg-pill visible), review card rendered with brand-color rating pill '4.25', 'avg 4.25' badge, StarDisplay row, and 'HC 8.4' underneath. Handicap filter chips (review-filter-all/low/mid/high) all present; filter=low keeps Reese (HC 8.4) visible and hides other-HC reviews as expected.

react_native_issues.issue: Non-blocking RN Web deprecation warning: '"shadow*" style props are deprecated. Use "boxShadow"'. Pre-existing from iter2/iter3.

action_items: (Optional, non-blocking) Migrate shadow* style props to boxShadow to silence RN Web deprecation warnings.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: /api/courses/reviews correctly rounds rating to nearest 0.25 server-side (round(rating*4)/4) and clamps to [1,5]; combined with Pydantic ge=1.0/le=5.0, values outside range return 422 before rounding. Solid.

server.py: /api/discover/courses aggregation merges master courses with rounds agg, computes review_count and avg_rating per course, and sorts played-first via key=(-play_count, name). Note: the aggregation runs one extra $group query per course — fine at 30-course scale but O(N) subqueries; acceptable for MVP.

server.py: /api/courses/import-osm correctly validates bbox format (400), requires auth via Depends, and wraps Overpass call with 502 fallback. Duplicate skip is by exact-name match which is fine for OSM.

course/[name].tsx: StarPicker onPress region uses PanResponder locationX + onLayout width — mapping (x/width)*5 rounded to 0.25 with min 0.25 / max 5 is exactly what the review request specifies. Verified live: 40% → 2.00, 85% → 4.25.
course/[name].tsx: openMaps builds google.com/maps URL from courseName + city + region and calls Linking.openURL — verified via window.open interception.

success_rate.backend: 100% (8/8, 1 skipped due to Overpass 502 — expected fallback per spec)
success_rate.frontend: 100% for all iter3 flows (Discover course list w/ city+region, Course Detail hero avg-pill + Open in Maps, StarPicker drag→0.25 step, fractional review submit, HC filter chips)

seed_data_creation: None manually. Auto-seed created 3 demo users + 30 courses + 4 rounds on startup. Tests created TEST_-prefixed rounds/reviews (course names containing 'TEST_') plus one review on 'Augusta National Golf Club' from reese@teebox.demo via the UI (rating 4.25).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iter3 fully verified end-to-end. All iter1/iter2 features still functional (feed, rounds, likes, comments, mentions — implicitly verified by the seed + feed rendering). Backend and frontend both green. OSM live call cannot be exercised from this environment (Overpass 502) but the endpoint's contract (400 on bad bbox, 401 without auth, 502 on network failure) is correct.
